Package index

Estimating funding

The revised Muskoka method applied end to end: bilateral disbursements weighted by purpose code, plus core contributions weighted by agency.

muskoka2()
Estimate a provider's RMNCH, SRHR or family-planning funding

Fetching OECD data

Retrieve the two sources the Muskoka method applies coefficients to. Both take an explicit price basis, because OECD rebases its own constant series with each release.

oecd_crs()
Fetch bilateral CRS disbursements for a donor
oecd_multi()
Fetch a provider's core contributions to multilateral agencies

Inspecting the method

How OECD recipients map to the World Bank and IHME source data, and which of them take a borrowed weight rather than one of their own.

recipient_map()
How OECD recipients map to the source data, and where borrowed weights come from

Classifying recipients

OECD classifies recipients geographically, by DAC List income tier and by World Bank income group, all at once. Each is a different cut of the same money, so each sums to the same total, and each can be cut at a chosen level.

crs_classify()
Total a donor's disbursements by recipient classification

Coefficient tables

The weights the method depends on. Most are global constants transcribed from the Donors Delivering for SRHR reports; four RMNCH weights vary by recipient and year and are computed from source data.

sector_weights
Sector weights for the revised Muskoka method
agency_weights
Multilateral agency weights for the revised Muskoka method
rmnch_recipient_weights
RMNCH weights that vary by recipient and year

Lookups

Reference data the fetchers depend on: which recipient codes are aggregates, how the hierarchy nests, and how report agency names map to OECD channel codes.

crs_recipients
CRS recipient codes: which are aggregates, which are countries
crs_recipient_tree
CRS recipient hierarchy edges
recipient_crosswalk
OECD recipients mapped to World Bank codes and geographic groups
agency_channels
Multilateral agency to OECD channel code crosswalk
